message: 完璧な仕事

name: Helena
message: 「Alright, everyone! Eyes on Tamiko-chan!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Eek!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Judging from the information gathered thus far, I can state with certainty that Lady Azel is in Ryuusei Town.」
Riesling-san's voice echoes through the Student Council room, which feels strangely cramped than usual with so many people packed inside.

name: Synn
message: 「Really?!」

name: Riesling
message: 「When it comes to finding people, leave it to me, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Having checked the security cameras at Ryuusei Town's station, convenience stores, banks, roads, and apartment buildings, we confirmed Lady Azel's presence as of the 16th.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's great news, but... are you even allowed to view that kind of footage?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai-san, that's what they call 'a snake's eye is a snake.' In other words, protective coloration!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You mean 'it takes a snake to know a snake's path,' right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya is not a snake!」

name: Shio
message: 「Is that the mouth that slanders Jiiya-dono as a serpent?! I shall strike that head from your shoulders!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You can chop it off, just wait until later.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wait, it's fine if it's later?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Wouldn't it be better to just say, 'leave rice cakes to the rice cake maker'?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya is not a rice cake either!」

name: Misa
message: 「What about the 17th?」

name: Riesling
message: 「There was no sign of her.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, didn't you just say she's in Ryuusei Town?」

name: Riesling
message: 「And that is precisely why I can state with certainty that she is in Ryuusei Town.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How can she be here if there's no sign of her?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooh, flash of genius! She's invisible! An evil scientist used her as a test subject!」

name: Sally
message: 「Awesome!」
Riesling-san steps up to the map pinned on the whiteboard, and

name: Riesling
message: 「The access points leading outside of Ryuusei Town consist of the port, two train stations, two major roads, and eleven regular roads, but--」

name: Riesling
message: 「Security or surveillance cameras are installed at every single one of those locations.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Footage taken in front of the station on the 16th at 18:15 is the most recent video of Lady Azel at this point.」

name: Riesling
message: 「And after that time, Lady Azel does not appear in any footage from the access points leading out of town.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see. So at the very least, it means she hasn't left town.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, saw. That girl. Night before last. In front of, Subaru House.」
The person responsible for 90% of why the Student Council room felt so cramped spoke up.

name: Riesling
message: 「Around what time would that be?」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Four, five. Around then.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Around four to five in the morning on the 17th, then. Thank you very much for the valuable information.」

name: Synn
message: 「She hasn't left town, yet she hasn't been caught on camera either... What could that mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Does it mean she's holed up somewhere?」

name: Misa
message: 「Like an abandoned house or an unused warehouse, perhaps? So we just need to search buildings like that all over Ryuusei Town, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「If we know that much, it'll be fine. I'll handle the rest--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What kind of sleep-talking is that? We're all going to search for her starting now!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm happy you all feel that way, but I really will search on my own. There's the Holy Night Festival to prepare for, too.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn. Searching all by yourself might be cool and dramatic, but no way is that happening.」

name: Misa
message: 「We can't leave it all to Sakura-kun alone. Even things we could find wouldn't get found that way.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not being honest with yourself, huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, shut up.」

name: Riesling
message: 「While I am deeply moved by everyone's sentiments, I have not finished speaking.」
Riesling-san took out another map and stuck it onto the whiteboard.
A red circle was drawn on it, completely enclosing the central area of Ryuusei Town.

name: Riesling
message: 「As a result of analyzing the photos Lady Azel had been taking, we have also determined her range of movement.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Within this circle two kilometers in diameter, any buildings with infrequent foot traffic that can also be freely entered and exited have already been searched.」

name: Riesling
message: 「We have also investigated accommodations such as hotels, karaoke boxes, and internet cafes. As a result, we were unable to locate Lady Azel.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So fast!?」

name: Synn
message: 「That much in just one day!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Compared to fighting in the scorching Sahara, it is nothing of consequence.」

name: Misa
message: 「The Sahara...?」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, the places she could be are limited.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Either she is sleeping rough outdoors, or a safe house was prepared in advance.」

name: Sally
message: 「Safe house?」

name: Ria
message: 「It means a hideout for emergencies.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not like she's a spy or anything...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Taking the previous information into account...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Lady Azel's hideout is narrowed down to a location reachable via a route from in front of the beef bowl shop Subaruya without being caught on camera.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel! You shouldn't make everyone worry like that! Sorry. 'Sorry' doesn't cut it! And then, as Azel and I embrace, a sob escapes Azel's lips.」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you suddenly going on about.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since it's practically the same as having found her already, I'm imagining that moment right now and getting all emotional.」

name: Misa
message: 「And then Sakura-kun says 'Welcome back' or something, right... Oh, that's actually kind of a nice scene.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, come back to reality.」

name: Riesling
message: 「We have installed additional cameras in various locations to eliminate blind spots, and are currently monitoring all entrances and exits of every building within the perimeter.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Even now, several comrades-in-arms are keeping watch, and I will be contacted the moment Lady Azel is spotted.」
Just what kind of life has this person lived...?

name: Helena
message: 「Tamiko-chan. Flawless work as always, I see.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Because I am a professional.」

name: Helena
message: 「That being said, all of you students should devote yourselves to preparing for the Holy Night Festival without a care in the world.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Eeeh!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's a reasonable conclusion.」

name: Synn
message: 「Please let me do something too!」

name: Helena
message: 「No way. This is an order from the Chairwoman.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, want, help. Ode, student, not.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya, you're so mean! Please leave some work for me too!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Even if you say that...」

name: Ria
message: 「I understand how everyone feels, and I want to look for Azel-chan too... but.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「We can't do any more than what Tooyama-han is already doing.」

name: Synn
message: 「That may be true, but...」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan. Even we can search for Azel-chan, but you all are the only ones who can prepare the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Helena
message: 「How do you think Azel-chan would feel if the Holy Night Festival wasn't at its best because you were out looking for her?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's why I'm handing this over to you.」

name: Synn
message: 「A cell phone?」

name: Helena
message: 「The moment Azel-chan is found, I'll let you know first.」
If I accept this, it'll mean I've agreed not to take part in the search....

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn. Just take it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sure, like Ria-senpai said, if you were the one to find Azel, that'd be all dramatic and romantic.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I'm aiming for.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, someone other than you can find Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know, though, there's no replacement for the Ryuusei Academy Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's Misa, isn't there.」

name: Misa
message: 「I can't take your place, you know. As frustrating as that is to admit.」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Don't get the wrong idea! I just mean there's less than a week until the Holy Night Festival, so there's no way I could take over as the person in charge!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If it's preparations for the Holy Night Festival, the rest of us can help out with that together.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But you know, sorting out the reason Azel walked out on us is something only you can do.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When you see Azel, nail it for us, Student Council President!」
I wondered why I'd never fallen for Nanaka as a girl.
My chest felt completely full.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Go get 'em!」
